plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the PulseGrid SCADA/EMS dashboard, validating primary monitoring flows, adjacent detail pages, interactive controls, and responsive mobile layouts.
plan.summary: The exploration will start by validating the primary dashboard overview and its high-density data visualizations, then proceed to adjacent detail pages (Generators, Forecast, Alarms) to test filtering and navigation. It will specifically target high-risk interactive controls like the BA selector, mode tabs, and alarm acknowledgement. Finally, critical paths will be re-validated on a mobile viewport to assess responsive layout and tap target issues.
assumptions: The BA selector and Production/Replay/Plan tabs dynamically alter the dashboard state or data, even if simulated.
The ⌘K button triggers a command palette or search overlay.
The ☾ theme toggle switches the UI to a dark mode suitable for control rooms.
Topology and Events links are placeholder anchors (#) and will not navigate to new content.
Alarm acknowledgement and filtering on alarms.html are interactive and affect the alarm state.
risk_hotspots: BA selector (ux-8) missing an accessible label, risking screen reader failure on a critical control
Small tap targets for top bar controls (Production/Replay/Plan, ⌘K) and left rail nav on mobile viewports
High-density data on index.html (KPIs, charts, generator grid) potentially overflowing or clipping on smaller screens
Alarm acknowledgement workflow on alarms.html (handling of unattended vs. open critical alarms)
Generator status filtering (ux-19 to ux-21) on index.html potentially conflicting with the full filter strip on generators.html

phases.title: Dashboard Overview Validation
phases.objective: Validate the primary SCADA dashboard layout, KPIs, and core interactive controls on desktop.
key_checks: Verify BA selector changes the context (Western / ERCOT / SPP / MISO)
Click Production, Replay, and Plan tabs to check for state changes
Toggle the ☾ theme to dark mode and verify contrast and readability
Click ⌘K to verify command palette/search opens
Click 🔔 to check alert/notification panel
Interact with chart time ranges (24h, 48h, 7d) and verify visual updates
Click generator status pills (All, Online, Tripped, Maintenance) to filter the 24-cell grid
exit_criteria: All top bar controls have been clicked and responses observed
Chart and generator grid filters function without layout breakage
Theme toggle successfully switches visual mode

phases.title: Generators Deep Dive
phases.objective: Validate the generator list page, focusing on filtering, searching, and detail access.
key_checks: Navigate from index.html 'View all 312 →' to generators.html
Type in the search input (e.g., 'Palo Verde') and verify table filters
Click status pills (Online 30, Ramping 3, Tripped 2, Maintenance 3)
Use 'All fuels' and 'All zones' dropdowns to filter the table
Click 'Details →' for a tripped unit (e.g., COL-3) to check for detail view/modal
exit_criteria: Search and all filter combinations yield correct table updates
No layout overflow in the wide data table

phases.title: Forecast & Alarms Adjacent Flows
phases.objective: Validate the forecast model views and the critical alarms management workflow.
key_checks: On forecast.html, switch Day-ahead / Hour-ahead / Real-time models
Click chart time ranges (12h, 24h, 7d) and tap an hourly row to overlay on chart
Navigate to alarms.html via the '⚠ Alarms 8' nav link
Select a critical alarm checkbox and click 'Acknowledge selected'
Use Severity, Status, and Time dropdowns to filter the alarm list
Type in the 'Filter by unit, rule, or owner…' input
exit_criteria: Forecast model and time range switches update the chart and table
Alarm acknowledgement action provides clear feedback
Alarm filters successfully narrow down the list

phases.title: Mobile Responsive & Accessibility Check
phases.objective: Re-validate critical flows and layout integrity on a mobile viewport, addressing known tap target and label issues.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and check for layout collapse/overflow on index.html KPIs and charts
Verify left rail navigation is accessible (e.g., hamburger menu) and usable despite small tap targets
Test BA selector accessibility and interaction on mobile
Check alarm list readability and checkbox tap targets on alarms.html
exit_criteria: Mobile layout renders without horizontal scroll on core pages
Navigation and critical selectors remain functional
Tap target and missing label issues are documented with visual evidence

coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible filters, selectors, and primary actions on each page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical dashboard and alarm checks on mobile viewport

notes: Topology and Events links point to '#' and are expected to be non-functional or placeholder; limit time spent on them.
Pay close attention to the high-density data points (like the 24-cell generator grid) for potential overlapping or truncation on standard and mobile views.
